title: Nil Input.state segfaults the existing input suite: draw_drag_on_a_node_never_pans (verified failing)
detail: commit_draw now routes through box_apply_edit, which derefs state.box_enabled with no nil check; the camera fixture's Input leaves state nil, so the first draw gesture crashes the test. CI leg ci.yml:77 (odin test app/input) is red.
recommended_fix: Wire ictx.state = &st in cam_test_ctx (mirroring exec_test.odin:73) and nil-guard the delegate: `if state == nil || !state.box_enabled` in box_apply_edit, so unwired Input stays legacy-safe.

title: stats_destroy does not free the new rec.box.pieces array — per-tick leak on box-on stats runs
detail: stats_destroy is the per-record teardown (harness/run.odin:485, app/main.odin:594); on box-on runs every stepped tick leaks one heap array, breaking the record's own run_init/destroy discipline.
recommended_fix: Add `delete(rec.box.pieces)` to stats_destroy before the `rec^ = {}` reset.

title: Box refusal on placement is silent — the place path never feeds last_reject (commit_draw does)
detail: Tray selection (exec.odin:114) doesn't gate on held pieces, so .Box_Piece_Exhausted fires at runtime with no toast — reject_label's authored "none of those in the box - teardown refunds pieces" (main.odin:2198) is unreachable from placement, contradicting tutorial-by-consequence.
recommended_fix: Mirror commit_draw's else on the placement path: set inp.last_reject/inp.reject_tick when box_apply_edit refuses a placement.

title: Router short-name mapping duplicated verbatim: draw_box_hud re-implements draw_tray's
detail: Identical id-shortening logic now lives twice in one file; a new router tier id would need both sites updated, and the era_row lookup repeats per loop iteration.
recommended_fix: Extract a shared router_short_name helper (or hoist the mapping beside draw_tray's) and hoist the era_row call above the loops.

title: Dead slot lookup in box_charge's Demolish_Node case — result discarded, refund rides the snapshot
detail: slot is never used; the refund comes entirely from the validate-time snapshot (the node is dead post-apply, so node_slot would return slot 0/!ok anyway). The odd over-indented line suggests an abandoned edit.
recommended_fix: Delete the `slot, _ := node_slot(t, c.node)` line and fix the indentation of the pieces line.
